title: GoalEvolve: From Handcrafted Algorithm Priors to Goal-Driven Evolution of Physical Design Algorithms
abstract: arXiv:2608.16733v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Physical design algorithms operate within tightly coupled, multi-stage optimization flows, where stage-local gains may vanish or induce downstream degradation. Existing program-evolution frameworks often rely on stage-local objectives or undifferentiated multi-metric feedback, which neither guarantee better final results nor identify which unmet requirement should guide the next iteration. We present GoalEvolve, a goal-driven framework that makes physical design algorithm evolution accountable for the final quality of results (QoR) of the complete flow. Given a multi-objective QoR target region, GoalEvolve converts unmet requirements into normalized target gaps, identifies the dominant bottleneck, and uses stage-resolved checkpoint evidence to locate the responsible stage. translated_title: GoalEvolve：从手工设计的算法先验到物理设计算法的目标驱动进化
translated_abstract: 物理设计算法在紧密耦合、多阶段的优化流程中运行，其中阶段局部增益可能消失或导致下游性能退化。现有的程序进化框架通常依赖于阶段局部目标或无差别的多指标反馈，这既不能保证更好的最终结果，也无法确定哪个未满足的需求应指导下一次迭代。我们提出了GoalEvolve，一个目标驱动的框架，使物理设计算法的进化对整个流程的最终质量结果（QoR）负责。给定一个多目标QoR目标区域，GoalEvolve将未满足的需求转化为归一化的目标差距，识别主导瓶颈，并使用阶段解析的检查点证据来定位责任阶段。基于LLM的教师模型随后将搜索范围缩小到相关的算法决策和源区域，而并行学生代理则实现并验证假设。
tldr: GoalEvolve通过目标驱动的瓶颈识别和责任阶段定位，将物理设计算法进化直接导向最终流程质量结果（QoR）的改进，从而克服了传统方法中阶段局部优化与全局目标脱节的问题。
en_tdlr: GoalEvolve directly guides physical design algorithm evolution toward final flow QoR improvement through goal-driven bottleneck identification and responsible-stage localization, overcoming the disconnect between stage-local optimization and global objectives in traditional methods.
